Under the current engine policy the expected result of every route is
null plus one {t:'popup'} event on the wire. If a route instead
returns a Window, the deny handler was bypassed — that is a finding, and route 5 (a real
user-gesture anchor) is the one most likely to expose it.




Cross-window scripting between two file:// documents is blocked: each file
URL is its own opaque origin. The child therefore reports back with
postMessage(..., '*') and also paints its own beacon, so the round trip is
observable even when property access is denied.
